About Canopy Road Glass Care

Canopy Road Glass Care is run by Joshua and Dylan, two Chiles High School students offering window cleaning in the North Tallahassee area.

We work hard, pay close attention to detail, and aim to leave every window spotless. You get a free estimate before any work starts, and a satisfaction guarantee after it.
